title: The Furies and the Titans
summary: How the Black Furies remember the age before Olympus.

claims.text: Black Fury legend calls the reign of the Titans a time of peace, when the Titans held male and female, sky and earth in balance and kept Gaia's laws much as the Furies did.
After the sky-gods cast the Titans down, the Furies had little love for the Olympians, though Luna is said to have walked among them as Artemis and spoken for the tribe.

title: Black Furies in South America
summary: How the tribe came south with European settlers.

claims.text: The Furies came to South America with Spanish and Portuguese missionaries, mostly nuns of the Order of Our Merciful Mother, and Freebooters followed in the wake of Latin settlers.
They were among the first Garou to meet the werecats of the Amazon, to build Kinfolk networks there and to warn the Western Concordat that the jungle was being destroyed.
Few tribes keep the peace with the rainforest's shapeshifters as reliably, though Freebooters still clash with the werecats over wild ground.

title: Amazons of Diana
summary: The largest Black Fury camp among the young.

claims.text: The Amazons of Diana are warriors before they are avengers, and they make up the biggest faction among young Black Furies.
They are quickest to defend the tribe's honour and lead its assaults, though some conservative elders look down on them.
Older Furies teach that an inner circle of the camp cares more for protection and prevention than for aggression.

title: The Bacchantes
summary: Black Furies who punish the worst violators of Gaia's law.

claims.text: The Bacchantes see themselves as the Vengeance of Gaia and claim the oldest traditions of the tribe.
Instead of chasing the Wyrm's most obvious works, they strike at the people behind the worst crimes against Gaia, far from human eyes; the larger attacks tend to pass for natural disasters.
When a sept is threatened by something like a Nexus Crawler or a pack of vampires, they fight beside the Amazons.

title: The Freebooters
summary: A shrinking Black Fury camp that seeks new wild places.

claims.text: The Freebooters search for Wyld places that can be dedicated to Gaia and made into caerns.
The camp shrinks faster than any other because so little wild land remains; the Temple of Artemis is smaller still.
A small group within the camp holds that a new body for Gaia must be found in a safe place in the Umbra, and the camp may split over it.
